submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I sampled the Co-rich, Mn-rich and Ca-rich corners of the spread. The Ca-rich film (idx 46, Ca0.54Co0.26Mn0.20) gave the highest photocurrent at 4e-8 A. Its XRD shows an extra low-Q reflection at Q about 1.16 1/Å, which points to a distinct Ca-containing phase. All the other XRD patterns were dominated by the same common reflections.

rejected.reason: Co-rich spinel-like film; photocurrent 1e-8 A, lower than 46
Mn-rich film; photocurrent -2e-8 A (no net anodic photoresponse)
XRD showed only the common peaks, no distinct phase; merit not measured because the budget was used on the corners
